## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Endpoints`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `endpoint-configurations`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Endpoints**.

## Step 2: Configure endpoint visibility

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration from the project home. -->
2. <!-- manual: On the integration overview page, locate the environment you want to configure. -->
3. Select **Configure** on that environment card.
4. In the runtime configurations drawer, select **Next** to go to the endpoint details step. The drawer lists all endpoints for the integration, with the current network visibility shown for each.
5. <!-- manual: Click the edit icon next to the endpoint you want to configure. The Network Visibility options appear. -->
6. <!-- manual: Select the visibility levels you want to enable. You can enable multiple levels at the same time. -->
7. Select **Update**.
8. Select **Apply**.
